volunteerExperiences.description: Our engineering missions team traveled to the Village of Hope in Ghana for two weeks to install solar panels at their high school and begin to implement a sanitation system. We also met with the science club to teach them about solar power and taught the teachers how to use the system.
Supervised and helped set up blood drive at Berlin High School
